Figure 7: UMAP projections computed on control cells for Trametinib at t = 24h. High predicted weights in the MelA+ cell type suggest proliferation, while the Sox9+ population shows higher levels of cell death. This prediction is confirmed by the relative cell counts, where MelA+ cell counts increase and Sox9+ counts decrease, demonstrating opposite response behaviors to Trametinib for each subpopulation, i.e., MelA+ cells show proliferation and Sox9+ cells death.
